title: Disks foe Escape The Backrooms
description: Adds 10 collectible soundtrack wheels from Escape The Backrooms and a special Unreal Engine default block for decoration, museums, showcases, and Backrooms-themed Minecraft maps.
body:
# Escape The Backrooms Wheels  

Bring the atmosphere of *Escape The Backrooms* directly into Minecraft with this unique decorative and soundtrack-focused expansion!  

This mod adds **10 collectible soundtrack wheels** inspired by the original music from *Escape The Backrooms*, allowing players to decorate maps, create interactive exhibits, build atmospheric locations, or simply enjoy the memorable sounds from the game. Each wheel represents a different soundtrack and serves as a tribute to the mysterious environments and unforgettable moments of the Backrooms experience.  

### Included Soundtrack Wheels  

* Main Menu  
* This Elevator Don't Kill You  
* You Day (Instrumental)  
* King's Curfew  
* Row Your Boat  
* Snackroosic  
* Run For It  
* You Day  
* Escapee  
* Walls Winding  

In addition to the soundtrack collection, the mod also includes a **special default block from Unreal Engine**, giving builders access to an iconic piece of development history that can be used for secret rooms, testing areas, easter eggs, or custom Backrooms-inspired environments.  

### Features  

✔ 10 unique soundtrack wheels based on music from Escape The Backrooms  
✔ 1 special Unreal Engine default block  
✔ Perfect for Backrooms-themed maps and roleplay servers  
✔ Great for museums, showcases, and custom adventures  
✔ Lightweight and easy to use  
✔ Compatible with custom building projects  

Whether you're recreating famous Backrooms levels, building your own liminal worlds, or expanding the Escape The Backrooms universe in Minecraft, this mod provides additional atmosphere, nostalgia, and creative possibilities.  

Step into endless corridors, relive memorable moments, and bring the sounds of the Backrooms to life.
